mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(notify_status IN ('PENDING','FAILED')),0) pending_notifications,COALESCE(SUM(notify_status='DEAD_LETTER'),0) dead_letters,MAX(CASE WHEN notify_status IN ('SENT','DELIVERED') THEN COALESCE(sent_at,updated_at) END) last_delivery_at FROM t_alert_notification WHERE record_type='NOTIFICATION'
